worldcombat.skill.splash.summary: One flop in the chosen direction: crouch, arc up, land — and nothing at all happens. No damage, no status, no one else touched. It can carry you over a step or out of the line of an attack; it is the only move that moves nobody but you.
worldcombat.skill.splash.use.0: Clear a step or a small stretch of water
worldcombat.skill.splash.use.1: Move yourself out of a line attack's landing spot
worldcombat.skill.splash.use.2: Reposition low and long to open a gap
worldcombat.skill.splash.description.0: The flop rises %1$s blocks and carries you up to %2$s blocks; it is movement and nothing else happens.
worldcombat.skill.splash.description.1: Remain airborne for %1$s. The player chooses the landing point.
worldcombat.skill.splash.leap.on: High leap: taller (height x1.35) but shorter (distance x0.7) — good for clearing a step or ducking a ground-hugging blow.
worldcombat.skill.splash.leap.off: Low and long: a low, far flop for repositioning and opening distance.
worldcombat.skill.splash.description.2: Crouch %1$s s, landing recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s; the move is cheap enough to use often.
worldcombat.skill.splash.timing: The flop reaches %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, %4$s PP and cooldown %5$s s from commit. It deals no damage and touches no other living thing.
worldcombat.skill.splash.preference.leap: On: hop height x1.35 but hop distance x0.7 and wind-up +1 tick — for clearing a step or ducking a ground-hugging blow. Off: low and long, for repositioning and opening distance.
worldcombat.skill.splash.preference.ai.m: The partner only considers a flop while a threat is this close; larger makes it reposition from farther out.
worldcombat.skill.splash.preference.ai.r: With an attack on hand, the partner treats the flop as an escape (higher priority) while below this health fraction and crowded; raise it to pull out sooner, lower it to hop only when nearly gone.
worldcombat.skill.splash.preference.ai.k: A foe this close counts as crowding the partner; only then does a partner that has an attack hop away, picking the landing spot with a freeSpace probe.
